cues: Till when they reached the other side, a dominie in gray: a dominie is a schoolmaster, and in America also a minister.

text: Stanza four. Till when they reached the other side, a dominie in gray: a dominie is a schoolmaster, and in America also a minister. In grey: the colour of dusk, and of a Puritan minister's coat. He has no face. He put gently up the evening bars: the bars are the poles that close a gap in a farm fence once the animals are in for the night. It is done gently; the poem insists on that. And led the flock away. The children have become sheep, the schoolmaster a shepherd: the oldest Christian image for God gathering the dead.
